name: Neon Truchet
description: Smith truchet arcs drawn as neon tubes: a bright white core inside a soft colored glow, the loops winding unbroken across a dark sheet.

code.style: --rule: ( --glow: @pd(@p(var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5))); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@p(0deg, 90deg)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(@var(--glow)); opacity: 0.62; -webkit-mask: @var(--ng); mask: @var(--ng); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1)); -webkit-mask: @var(--nc); mask: @var(--nc); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; --ng: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 24%, #000 50%, transparent 76%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 24%, #000 50%, transparent 76%); --nc: radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 0 0, transparent 46.5%, #000 46.5% 53.5%, transparent 53.5%), radial-gradient(circle farthest-side at 100% 100%, transparent 46.5%, #000 46.5% 53.5%, transparent 53.5%); } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
